scope: Project-authored local filesystem simulation on POSIX; no second operating-system user or external tool side effect is involved.

selected.title: Replace the claim directory
selected.explanation: A writable root lets a local actor rename the child directory containing spent markers. The old store accepts the same approval again after the replacement.

selected.title: Delete a spent marker
selected.explanation: A traversable root and writable claim directory let a local actor remove a marker. The old store accepts a second claim.

selected.title: Redirect claim storage
selected.explanation: A symlink to an outside directory was followed by the old store. The fixed store rejects it before issuing a grant.

selected.title: Private directory control
selected.explanation: With private, owner-controlled directories, the first claim succeeds and a replay is rejected by both versions.
